published_prior_art.cite: No cited paper states this exact refinement-image gluing lemma; it is a standard set-theoretic gluing equivalence.
ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCF gives fixed-graph finite canonical SCMs, not a positive same-law collision across exact refinements.
YvernesEtAl2026DerivationGraphs normalizes single-kernel do-calculus derivations; its conclusion leaves finite representations for ID-level algebraic derivation spaces open.

FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG proves rule-level completeness under its cluster-size assumption, while its conclusion identifies cross-iteration reconciliation and complete nonidentification as limitations.
AnandRibeiroTianBareinboim2023CDAG proves ID completeness for acyclic C-DAGs; FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG excludes known-size singleton-cycle cases from its completeness regime.
BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022Semiparametric supplies fixed-graph influence-function inference; the asserted finite-multinomial circuit delta-method layer is a routine adaptation.

FangSantos2019DirectionalInference and standard multinomial concentration cover the underlying nonregular-inference ingredients; the guard-image formulation is a useful but supplementary specialization.

soundness_flags.label: def:guarded-circuit / Eval
soundness_flags.one_line: Guards are expressly allowed to overlap, but Eval requires a unique branch containing p; specify a deterministic priority rule or define evaluation as the common branch value.

soundness_flags.label: def:plugin-estimator; thm:smooth-stratum-inference
soundness_flags.one_line: Ftilde_S and J_F are defined only on U, whereas phat_N may lie outside U at finite N, so define a total fallback or restrict Qhat_N and Sigmahat to the high-probability event phat_N∈U.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The standard ID algorithm is sound and complete for macro effects in a C-DAG and returns a formula valid in all compatible causal diagrams; failure entails a compatible diagram where the effect is not identifiable.
The paper provides a sufficient simultaneous-identification criterion for candidate SA-MPDAGs and explicitly discusses the difficulty of proving necessity for arbitrary candidate sets.
The paper gives a complete identification algorithm and nonidentification characterization for a single PAG equivalence class.
Canonical finite-domain SCM families are constructed for a fixed causal diagram and used to formulate sharp counterfactual bounds as polynomial programs.
The paper develops influence-function and weight-based estimation for identifiable hidden-variable graphical effects, including a complete identification-to-estimation procedure.

The paper proves a four-rule normal form for equivalent interventional densities, but says ID-level spaces with products, marginalizations, and divisions are generally infinite and asks whether meaningful finite representations or tractable subclasses exist.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make guarded evaluation total: replace uniqueness by priority-ordered guards or common-value evaluation, and define the plug-in objects outside the local extension neighborhood.
Add an explicit smallest known-size singleton-cycle quotient with labelled refinements and rational positive common-law tables, showing the claimed local-ID/global-disagreement separation concretely.

State the overlap-normal-form invariant, terminal certificate encoding, and a realistic intermediate state bound before asserting the E4 output bound; retain the bound as conditional until that construction is supplied.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two definition-domain defects, then advance the overlap-normal-form OEQ with a concrete singleton-cycle witness and a specified saturation invariant.
